summary: Raise this module's Go toolchain floor to 1.26.9 so the nine standard-library fixes shipped in that release are enforced when the CLI is built.
reason: With go 1.26.6 in go.mod, publish-time govulncheck reported nine reachable standard-library vulnerabilities in net/http, crypto/tls and net/textproto, all fixed in go1.26.9 (GO-2026-6603, 6605, 6607, 6608, 6610, 6611, 6612, 6613, 6617). The README and SKILL install sections keep the generator's 1.26.6 wording: verify-skill rejects any edit to that generator-owned text, and the default GOTOOLCHAIN downloads 1.26.9 on demand, so a user on an older toolchain still builds a fixed binary. Eight CLIs in the catalog are already on go 1.26.9.
validated_outcome: `go run golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.3.0 ./...` goes from 9 reachable standard-library vulnerabilities to none reachable (7 in required modules, not called); `go build ./...` passes on go1.26.9, and `cli-printing-press verify-skill --dir .` passes with the install sections untouched.
